criterion: Given the V4 launcher URL is available to the QA user, when the user opens it in a browser, the V4 launcher interface is displayed without an error page or a loading state remaining on screen.
steps_taken: Returned to the required V4 launcher URL in the Playwright browser.
Opened the required launcher URL and waited for navigation to complete.
Confirmed the Metricell launcher interface was displayed with no error page or persistent loading state.
reason: The launcher completed loading and displayed the Metricell launcher interface.

criterion: Given the V4 launcher page is displayed, the browser evidence shows the page together with its URL in the browser address bar.
steps_taken: Returned to the required V4 launcher URL in the same Playwright page.
Read and recorded the current browser URL before the initial screenshot.
Confirmed the visible page was the Metricell launcher and the Playwright browser reported the launcher URL.
reason: The browser-derived URL was https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher while the launcher page was visibly displayed.

criterion: Given the V4 launcher page has loaded, at least one V4 module card is visible on the page.
steps_taken: Returned to the required V4 launcher URL in the same Playwright page.
Read and recorded the current browser URL before the initial screenshot.
Inspected the loaded launcher and confirmed visible module cards including Agentic AI, GIS, Dashboards, and Customer Care.
reason: Multiple V4 module cards were visible on the loaded launcher page.
